import struct
data = open('/tmp/main_fixed-wal','rb').read()

def cksum(data, s1=0, s2=0, big=True):
    for i in range(0, len(data), 8):
        if big:
            x = int.from_bytes(data[i:i+4],'big')
            y = int.from_bytes(data[i+4:i+8],'big')
        else:
            x = int.from_bytes(data[i:i+4],'little')
            y = int.from_bytes(data[i+4:i+8],'little')
        s1 = (s1 + x + s2) & 0xFFFFFFFF
        s2 = (s2 + y + s1) & 0xFFFFFFFF
    return s1, s2

magic = struct.unpack('>I', data[:4])[0]
print('magic', hex(magic))
# header checksum over first 24 bytes
for big in (True, False):
    s1,s2 = cksum(data[:24], big=big)
    stored1 = struct.unpack('>I', data[24:28])[0]
    stored2 = struct.unpack('>I', data[28:32])[0]
    print('big' if big else 'little', 'computed', hex(s1), hex(s2), 'stored', hex(stored1), hex(stored2), 'MATCH' if (s1==stored1 and s2==stored2) else 'no')
"

import struct
data = open('/tmp/main_fixed-wal','rb').read()

def cksum(data, s1=0, s2=0):
    for i in range(0, len(data), 8):
        x = int.from_bytes(data[i:i+4],'little')
        y = int.from_bytes(data[i+4:i+8],'little')
        s1 = (s1 + x + s2) & 0xFFFFFFFF
        s2 = (s2 + y + s1) & 0xFFFFFFFF
    return s1, s2

hdr = data[:32]
salt1, salt2 = struct.unpack('>II', hdr[16:24])
s1, s2 = cksum(hdr[:24])
print('header cksum ok:', (s1,s2)==struct.unpack('>II',hdr[24:32]))

pgsz = 4096
frame_size = 24 + pgsz
off = 32
i = 0
while off + frame_size <= len(data):
    fh = data[off:off+24]
    pgno, dbsize, fs1, fs2, fc1, fc2 = struct.unpack('>IIIIII', fh)
    page = data[off+24:off+24+pgsz]
    # checksum over first 8 bytes of frame header + page data
    s1, s2 = cksum(fh[:8] + page, s1, s2)
    ok_salt = (fs1, fs2) == (salt1, salt2)
    ok_ck = (s1, s2) == (fc1, fc2)
    print(f'frame {i}: pgno={pgno} dbsize={dbsize} salt_ok={ok_salt} cksum_ok={ok_ck}')
    off += frame_size
    i += 1
print('total frames:', i)
"
